intendedObjective: Lightly improve flow while retaining humor and the unresolved possibility of singing later.
acceptableEditScope: Light changes to transitions or wording; no reframing of skipping the turn as triumph or failure.
stableFactsAndClaims: The friend added the narrator to karaoke while the narrator read the menu and chose a familiar song without prior agreement.
The narrator delayed asking removal while the host handled a cable.
The outing celebrated the friend's new job after months of applications.
One singer brought a tambourine; another forgot a verse and continued; both received applause.
The narrator asked to skip, the host calmly moved on, and nobody demanded an explanation.
The friend sang confidently with imperfect tuning; the narrator cheered.
The evening was good; returning and singing next time remain qualified possibilities.
ambiguity: The narrator has not decided whether to sing next time.
voiceConstraints: Conversational humor, self-awareness, understated social observations.
Avoid an imposed success or failure narrative.
